operator_instruction.text: 完整 GPU 希望至少運作 24HR 的量，你盡量安排，直到我們能找到 eval model 在哪個臨界點失靈

launch_authorization.scope: score 87,653 pre-built 10 s clips (metric_win_tie_126b_stimuli.py, CPU, already on NVMe): 402 famous-piece MIDI excerpts (9 Mutopia classical piano pieces + 10 CSD nursery melodies) x 2 SoundFonts x 42 note-level single-variable cases (wrong/random pitch, position/pitch shuffle, jitter, unsteady tempo, block shuffle, retrograde, drop/extra notes, blast notes; soft: transpose +-1, tempo +-2/5 %, velocity x0.85), the 52 126a signal variants on one SoundFont and on the real/poor recordings (CSD sung, YouTube pro and presumed-poor piano and child singing), and 174 floor clips (white noise, +-1 / 0-1 binary waveforms, square, sine, sweep, pulse train, DC, silence); AES + MEva + CLAP(batch 1) + VGGish frames per clip; MIR precomputed on CPU. No generation, no training.

question: Do the metrics rank an obviously wrong performance of a famous piece (wrong notes, shuffled notes, blast notes) below the correct one, tie musically irrelevant changes (transpose 1 semitone, 2 % tempo, SoundFont swap), rank pro > poor > MIDI sensibly, and put every floor (incl. binary 0/1 waveforms) below real music?

fixed_protocol.judgment: delta = score(case) - score(clean base, same excerpt); tie if |delta| <= m, m = 0.10 S; S = 126a S (5-system clean range) for neural metrics, SD of 126b clean clips for MIR; pass = 80 % of pairs; m curve 0..0.5 S reported
fixed_protocol.cross: per piece pro vs poor vs MIDI unpaired win rates; CSD real vs MIDI paired; poor child singing vs CSD real; SoundFont swap as soft tie
fixed_protocol.floors: fraction of real/MIDI clean clips scoring below each floor; floor vs white noise at the same level
fixed_protocol.fad: VGGish frames per clip (float16); FAD per case vs its clean bases, per floor vs all music
fixed_protocol.reading: no human ratings; poor = presumed from title, listened manifest vetoes applied; PC and MIR have no human validation here

resume.note: unit-level restart: a unit with matching keys, done.json and vggish_frames is skipped; a partial one is redone whole; mir.json skipped if present

completion_evidence.method: guest writes terminal with sha256 of the registered summary after --validate-only passes
